snapshot.title: Firmware Update Acceptance — UAS-02

lines.msg: Firmware Update Accepted — UAS-02 received and applied firmware version 2.4.11a (SHA-256: d4e9a1f7b2c8e6d1a3f4b5c6e7f8a9b0c1d2e3f4g5h6i7j8k9l0m) from GCS-01
Update not listed in current campaign’s pre-flight checklist (FOM-1 Annex B)
No approval record in Campaign Plan (FOM-1) for firmware version 2.4.11a
Firmware update not signed or verified per HUOG-ISP Section 4.4
Update file not in approved path: /opt/huog/firmware/signed/2.4.11a.bin
Update accepted via 915 MHz downlink (GCS-01 → UAS-02)
Firmware version 2.4.11a not in GCS-01 configuration baseline (HUOG-ISP Section 4)
Firmware update not confirmed by hover test at Horton Field (per FOM-4)

snapshot.instructorNote: This log reveals the unauthorized firmware update that triggered the loss of control. The ASO must halt all operations on UAS-02 and any aircraft running version 2.4.11a, while the SCL confirms the update was not approved or verified.
